root_cause.text: The `mpr_spi_xfer` function in the `mprls0025pa` IIO pressure sensor driver allocates a `struct spi_transfer` on the stack without initialization, leaving its fields populated with uninitialized stack memory when processed by the SPI subsystem.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the declaration of `struct spi_transfer xfer;` in `drivers/iio/pressure/mprls0025pa_spi.c` being changed to `struct spi_transfer xfer = { };` to ensure the structure is zero-initialized before use.

bic_trace_step.reason: In the function `mpr_spi_xfer`, the `struct spi_transfer xfer` is declared on the stack without initialization (line 43). Only the fields `tx_buf`, `rx_buf`, and `len` are explicitly assigned values (lines 49-51), leaving the remaining fields of the structure populated with uninitialized stack memory when it is passed to `spi_sync_transfer` on line 53.
